ignore.reason: Chrome around every section (frame, fallbacks, navigation model): shared by all sections, a dependency of none in particular.
The shell (top bar, KPI bar, product bar, View selector) is on every screen; its reads are not a dependency of the section being shown.
View-selector widget (docs/VUE_AGREGEE.md): every section follows the View, so every section would depend on the consolidation.

sharedNote: Modules of the shared lane (zones foundation and presentation: types, context, inputs seam, formatting, document accessors) never create an edge: they are plumbing, listed in the Zones tab.
